app_name: Brother Seafood Bali - Travel Agent Proposal Generator & Tracker

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1A1513]
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold text-[#8B1A1A]

typography.trilingual_display_guidelines: Present English (EN), Chinese (中文), and Bahasa Indonesia (ID) clearly. In proposal document views, display stacked trilingual headers or synchronized side-by-side / accordion toggles. Ensure typography for Chinese characters uses fallback 'PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif' for pristine rendering.

visual_enhancers.print_styles: A4 page dimensions (@page { size: A4; margin: 15mm; }), white background, zero app chrome (hide navbar, sidebar, buttons, and floating widgets on window.print()).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 md:p-8
grids_and_layouts.proposal_document_layout: max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-white p-8 md:p-12 shadow-2xl rounded-xl border border-[#C9A227]/30 my-8 print:my-0 print:p-0 print:shadow-none print:border-none

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1). Gold headers on dark maroon background use explicit high contrast #FFFFFF or #FAF8F5 text.
accessibility.interactive_states: Hover, focus, and active states explicitly defined with distinct backgrounds and focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C9A227]).

shadcn_primitives_used: Dialog / Modal for Adding TA Visit & Editing Packages
Tabs for Trilingual Toggle / Proposal Sections
Table for Contract Rates, Commission Structure, & TA Tracker
Select & DropdownMenu for Package Selection & TA Filter
Sonner for Toast Notifications on Create / Edit / Save / Export
Input / Textarea / Checkbox for Proposal Customization Form

print_export_handling.pdf: Trigger window.print() with custom @media print CSS targeting #printable-proposal div
print_export_handling.docx: Generates real downloadable .docx blob containing proposal tables, branding, terms, and contract rates using docx / file-saver library in frontend.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user interactions feature micro-animations and proper loading states.
Implement the 3 main user requirements: (1) Proposal Generator with print (A4 PDF) & DOCX export, (2) Travel Agent Visit Tracker with per-TA totals, and (3) Settings for Logo & Photo Gallery.
Display all 3 languages (English, Chinese, Bahasa Indonesia) seamlessly in the proposal output document.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, input fields, tables, action buttons, and summaries.
Strictly follow gold (#C9A227) and maroon (#8B1A1A) branding colors with Playfair Display headings and Lato body.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers or dropdown containers.
Do NOT center align body text globally.
Maintain responsive layouts with mobile-first grid structures.
Always include robust fallback data for previewing proposal templates.
Always test export functions (PDF print view and DOCX download generation) with real data.
